chapter_seo_title: The Wandering Lord – Dao Twisted World Chapter 31
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang learns a terrible truth: summoning the Wandering Lord costs three months of his life. Still, he takes the ghost opera deal. Survival has a price.
og_title: The Wandering Lord Has a Price Tag
og_description: Li Huowang’s first real transaction in the Dao-Twisted World—power, money, and a ticking clock made of his own lifespan.
